dpt annotation: INCOMPLETE (3 criticals; parser abstention) — fifth straight Erik pin the
floor instrument cannot fully read.
Agent's reading: maximalism in a second register — streetwear/e-sports where Pete's (004) is
trattoria. Stark black-and-white chassis, hyper-saturated product art carrying ALL the color
(rabbit mascot, graffiti energy), acid yellow-green accent chips, marquee ticker bands ("FUEL
DIFFERENT"), sticker badges, grid-paper texture. The monochrome UI is the frame; the product
is the fireworks. Shares with 004: mascot as world-builder, tickers, badge vocabulary, total
conviction. Contrast with 004: cool/urban vs warm/rustic — the maximalist pole itself has
poles. Taste signal unchanged: conviction over volume, and the chassis stays disciplined so
the loudness lands.
